  "situation": "A DOE contractor employee who holds a security clearance disclosed on a questionnaire that she used marijuana edibles on two occasions while possessing a clearance. The Local Security Office raised concerns under Guideline H and the Bond Amendment, issuing a Letter of Interrogatory and a Notification Letter stating substantial doubt about her eligibility. At a hearing, the employee testified that the uses occurred in November 2017 to alleviate motion sickness, that she felt no effect, and that she has not used marijuana since. She provided a signed statement of intent to abstain from illegal drug use and disposed of the remaining edibles. Witnesses, including her husband and colleagues, testified they have never observed her using marijuana, that she has no drug‑using associates, and that she disposed of the edibles. The DOE’s April 2021 memorandum defines an unlawful user as a current user or one who has lost self‑control, and an addict as a habitual user, while the Bond Amendment bars clearance for such persons.",
